Public function release-check review — 2026-11-04

The JSON snapshot contains catalog definitions and grants only, no user rows.
The release SQL verifies exact definitions and effective browser permissions in
a read-only transaction. It never invokes application functions or grants access.
There are 19 grant-bearing signatures: 17 ordinary functions and two invoker
triggers, plus the inaccessible retired settlement stub. Eight have anonymous
EXECUTE (six ordinary functions, two triggers).
The trigger entries are pinned too; they are not executable as standalone RPCs.

Review of changes since the September snapshot:

- is_admin now requires an active owner admin. pickup_actor_role similarly
  excludes non-owner admins. Neither trusts client metadata or supplied IDs.
  Native coverage: admin-workspace-postgres.test.mjs.
- has_active_club_deal returns public offer eligibility. Its demo fallback is
  restricted by the synthetic club slug, owner email, dataset marker and banned
  owner account; it does not return account details or write anything.
- accept_dancer_agreement and dancer_agreement_access use auth.uid(); acceptance
  requires an active dancer and the current agreement, and is idempotent.
  Native coverage: dancer-agreement-database.test.mjs.
- dancer_age_verification_access returns the global requirement flag and only
  the signed-in user's verification status. No identity documents are returned.
- confirm_admission_pass requires active authorized staff for the pass's club,
  locks/rechecks the record, verifies arrival/hours/expiry, and prevents duplicate
  admission. get_venue_admission_metrics restricts the club and caps the period
  at 32 days. Native coverage: admission-pass-postgres.test.mjs.
- pickup_manageable_venues uses the current actor and club authorization helper,
  returns bounded club metadata (200), and permits owner admins. Native coverage:
  pickup-security-postgres.test.mjs and admin-workspace-postgres.test.mjs.
- staff_session_security checks the signed-in user's live session, active admin
  account, expiry and suspension; MFA additionally needs aal2 and a verified
  TOTP factor bound to that session and user. Native: staff-mfa-postgres.test.mjs.
- valid_venue_weekly_hours is an immutable invoker JSON validator, no data access.
  Native coverage: venue-weekly-hours-postgres.test.mjs.
- guard_admin_workspace_role and audit_admin_media_review are invoker triggers;
  the former blocks ordinary callers changing staff scope, the latter checks
  review claims and records decisions. No definer privilege is granted by them.
  Native coverage: admin-workspace-postgres.test.mjs.
- is_current_dancer_owner/is_current_venue_owner are now included in the single
  snapshot. Their bodies, ownership, empty search path and exact ACL stay pinned.

Unchanged interfaces: current_user_role, placeholder address, liquor-related
offer validator and unused-redemption voiding.

Per-guest billing retirement: settle_deal_revenue_event now always raises a
retirement error, uses SECURITY INVOKER with an empty search path, and has no
PUBLIC, anonymous, authenticated or service-role execution grant. Its inert body
and owner-only ACL are pinned. The migration preserves all financial history.
Native coverage: retired-per-guest-billing-postgres.test.mjs. Unused settlement
wrappers were removed; unused-redemption voiding retains its existing boundary.
MFA coverage and password-policy findings remain separate hardening work.

Failure tests exercise body/security-mode drift, anonymous/extra/inherited grants,
ownership, role capabilities, schema writes, search paths, and accidental writes.
New function names or changed bodies still require manual review, not auto-sync.
